summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Zendesk OAuth 2.0 migration. All 27 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all critical elements working correctly: OAuth Not Configured warning displayed, subdomain input with .zendesk.com suffix, disabled Connect button when OAuth not configured, subdomain normalization preview, and setup guide link.
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - OAuth implementation follows best practices with PKCE, state validation, and proper error handling
Token refresh logic is well-implemented with automatic rotation
Frontend correctly handles all OAuth states (not configured, connected, needs reauth)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zendesk OAuth migration fully tested. ZENDESK_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and ZENDESK_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET env vars are intentionally NOT set - this is expected until the user's Zendesk admin creates the OAuth client. All error handling for this state is working correctly. Key endpoints tested: GET /api/admin/zendesk-config (returns oauth_configured: false), GET /api/admin/zendesk/oauth/callback-url, POST /api/admin/zendesk/oauth/start (returns 400 with descriptive message), GET /api/zendesk/oauth/callback (handles errors gracefully with redirects). Frontend page at /admin/zendesk has data-testid attributes: zendesk-settings-page, zendesk-connection-card, zendesk-subdomain-input, zendesk-oauth-connect-btn.

features_tested.feature: GET /api/admin/zendesk-config returns oauth_configured: false when env vars not set
features_tested.details: Returns {oauth_configured: false, connected: false, auth_type: null} correctly

features_tested.feature: POST /api/admin/zendesk/oauth/start returns 400 when ZENDESK_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID not set
features_tested.details: Returns descriptive error: 'Zendesk OAuth is not configured yet...'
Empty and whitespace-only subdomains are rejected

features_tested.feature: GET /api/zendesk/oauth/callback with invalid state returns redirect with error
GET /api/zendesk/oauth/callback with missing code returns redirect with error
features_tested.details: Returns 302 redirect with appropriate error message

features_tested.feature: GET /api/zendesk/oauth/callback with error=access_denied returns user-friendly redirect
features_tested.details: Returns message about user denying authorization

features_tested.feature: PUT /api/admin/zendesk-config returns 400 when no connection exists
features_tested.details: Returns 'Connect Zendesk first before changing settings'

features_tested.feature: DELETE /api/admin/zendesk-config removes connection and cleans up OAuth states
features_tested.details: Returns success: true and config is verified as deleted

features_tested.feature: POST /api/admin/zendesk-config/test returns 400 when no connection exists
Frontend shows 'OAuth Not Configured' warning when env vars not set
features_tested.details: Red alert with ZENDESK_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and ZENDESK_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET mentioned

features_tested.feature: Frontend shows subdomain input with .zendesk.com suffix
features_tested.details: Input field with suffix span displayed correctly

features_tested.feature: Frontend Connect button is disabled when OAuth not configured
features_tested.details: Button has opacity: 0.5 and is not clickable
Plain subdomain, full domain, HTTPS URL, and uppercase all normalized correctly

features_tested.feature: OAuth callback endpoint is public (no auth required)

features_tested.details: GET/PUT/DELETE config, oauth/start, callback-url all return 401 without auth

auth_requirements.oauth_callback: Public (no auth) - uses state parameter for security
auth_requirements.webhook: Public - uses secret in URL path

note: ZENDESK_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and ZENDESK_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET are intentionally NOT set. The OAuth flow cannot be fully end-to-end tested until the user's Zendesk admin creates the OAuth client. All error handling for this state has been verified.
